note: Questions a Monash student would ask about special consideration, exams, withdrawing, dates and DSS. Written by the team on 2026-11-10 from the pages in the corpus; gold = page ids that answer the question (any one counts). 'campus' narrows the search the way the desk does when a student picks a campus first; questions without it are searched across every campus. Real student questions are added as they arrive, marked source 'student'.
